def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    df.loc[~df['species'].isin(['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']), 'species'] = pd.NA
    # convert text-stored numbers
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix negative flipper lengths (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # fix body mass out of range (grams written as milligrams)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # bill length range check
    df.loc[(df['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (df['bill_length_mm'] > 60), 'bill_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # sex: leave missing as unknown
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['island'])
    counts = d.groupby('island').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
